analysis.one_line_summary: A creator with thick curly hair demonstrates the Wavytalk Steamline Pro steam straightening brush, showing how it straightens without heat damage.
analysis.full_description: A creator showcases Wavytalk's Steamline Pro steam hair straightener. She begins by holding up the pink steam straightener with half her hair straightened and half curly. She refills the water reservoir, turns it on, and brushes out a section of her thick, long wavy/curly hair. The video demonstrates the steam emitting from the tool and the brush smoothly gliding down her hair in one pass, taking it from curly to sleek and pin-straight. She then styles the root near the scalp, flips her shiny straightened hair to show the back and sides, and poses happily holding the tool at the end.

analysis.transcript_full_original: Let's try Wavytalk's new Steamline Pro Steam Hair Straightener. I have naturally very thick, very long, wavy slash curly hair. I was so nervous that this product was not going to work for me, but boy was I wrong. The Steamline Pro just glided through my hair thanks to its combs, and the steam really helped to lock in the moisture and make my hair super soft. The combs allow you to get really close to your scalp without burning yourself. To achieve a more blown out look next time, I think I'll use the glove so I can really create that bend on the end of my hair. If you're not trying to achieve more of a blowout look like I was, this product is perfect for just combing straight through for bone straight hair.

I was so nervous that this product was not going to work for me, but boy was I wrong. The Steamline Pro just glided through my hair thanks to its combs, and the steam really helped to lock in the moisture and make my hair super soft. The combs allow you to get really close to your scalp without burning yourself. To achieve a more blown out look next time, I think I'll use the glove so I can really create that bend on the end of my hair. If you're not trying to achieve more of a blowout look like I was, this product is perfect for just combing straight through for bone straight hair.
